## Review checklist

See the full checklist in `docs/requirements/engineering-standards.md#code-review-checklist`.

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, keys, or real `.env` values
- [ ] No real PII; data is synthetic
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing
- [ ] Migrations are new files, apply cleanly, and docs (ERD, data dictionary) are updated
- [ ] Errors use the standard envelope; logs include `correlationId` and no sensitive data
- [ ] Docs and README links updated
